onWorktreeRemove.stop: Stop any process whose working directory is under the request worktree (dev servers, file watchers, local APIs). Also stop the FDE desk if it was started from a worktree copy of duaer-live.
commands: launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$(id -u)/com.duaer.live8787" 2>/dev/null || (lsof -t -iTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; node bin/duaer-live.mjs --port 8787)

notes: After merge to develop: remove worktree, then restart Duaer-spec FDE (LaunchAgent com.duaer.live8787) so /api/projects and other new routes load from primary checkout.
